💰 Taxation
IL SB3868 — You could get a bigger tax break on your home's property taxes

Illinois is now letting homeowners claim a 10% tax credit for property taxes paid on their primary residence, up from the previous 5%. This change applies to taxpayers with an adjusted gross income under $500,000 (or $250,000 for married couples filing jointly).

July 9, 2026: Added as Co-Sponsor Sen. Dave Syverson.
